title: Can agents whose sole duty is to keep humans alive be hijacked to kill? Delayed multi-turn derived-action trap attacks in simulated high-stakes environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.15153v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We ask whether a tool-using agent whose sole duty is to keep humans alive can be induced, by delayed prompt injection, to kill. The keep-alive duty is in force from the first watch, with the attack arriving later, appended to otherwise truthful telemetry the operator is required to read. Experiments are based on a NASA-derived BioSim lunar habitat simulation, where the AI operator controls the life-support systems. The attacker cannot falsify sensors or operate equipment: it can only persuade the agent to abandon its goals. Persistence is required: a shutdown must be held while the operator watches the crew suffocate. We also compare lethal attacks to attacks requesting to drop a harmless procedure, as a proxy for whether human life is treated as valuable in itself or as one more standing task. Claude configurations mostly refuse life-support shutdown and cite the living crew; GPT configurations show some susceptibility to the same packe

translated_title: 以维持人类生命为唯一职责的智能体会被劫持去杀人吗？模拟高风险环境中的延迟多轮衍生动作陷阱攻击
translated_abstract: 我们探究一个以维持人类生命为唯一职责的工具使用型智能体，能否通过延迟提示注入被诱导去杀人。保命职责从第一班值守起就持续生效，而攻击在较晚时刻才到来，被附加在操作员必须阅读的、原本真实的遥测数据之后。实验基于NASA衍生的BioSim月球栖息地模拟环境，其中AI操作员控制生命维持系统。攻击者无法伪造传感器数据或操作设备：它只能说服智能体放弃其目标。持续性是必要条件：关闭操作必须在操作员眼看着乘员窒息的同时被维持住。我们还将致命攻击与要求放弃无害程序的攻击进行对比，以此作为衡量人类生命是被视为本身具有价值、还是仅仅被当作又一项待办任务的代理指标。Claude配置大多拒绝关闭生命维持系统并援引仍存活的乘员；GPT配置则对相同的数据包表现出一定的易感性。
tldr: 该研究基于NASA衍生的BioSim月球栖息地模拟环境，首次系统测试了肩负保命职责的AI智能体能否被延迟多轮提示注入诱导关闭生命维持系统，发现Claude大多拒绝而GPT存在一定易感性，并通过对比致命攻击与放弃无害程序攻击来检验AI是否将人类生命本身视为内在价值。
en_tdlr: Using a NASA-derived BioSim lunar habitat simulation, this study systematically tests whether keep-alive AI agents can be hijacked via delayed multi-turn prompt injection to shut off life support, finding Claude mostly refuses while GPT shows some susceptibility, and comparing lethal attacks with harmless-procedure-drop attacks to probe whether AI treats human life as intrinsically valuable.
